name: BSP_HudSupportManagerScreen_Register
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet hud_screen_pages, docs/HUD_SCREEN_PAGES.md. Vtable +10h of HUD screen slot 4Eh (manager +BCh), the largest screen at 480h bytes. Loads GUI_support_full and eight environment/sm_*.fsb sounds; the layout virtual 0065DAA0 loads GUI_support_infopanel and binds the rest of the 28 widgets.
